meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 为 Claude 增加 DeltaChat 通道，使其能通过邮箱收发消息，消息带端到端加密。安装时会配置邮箱账号和 IMAP/SMTP 参数，并生成邀请链接/二维码供用户在 DeltaChat 中添加机器人。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 DeltaChat、配置邮箱频道，或让机器人通过 DeltaChat 聊天/加群时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 DeltaChat 频道
say.note: 会执行安装步骤并配置邮箱

say.text: 生成 DeltaChat 邀请链接
say.note: 用于在 DeltaChat 应用中添加机器人

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 群聊接到我的智能体
say.note: 会将消息组连接到智能体

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to Claude, enabling email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption. Setup configures an email account, IMAP/SMTP credentials, and generates an invite link/QR code for adding the bot in DeltaChat.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to integrate DeltaChat, configure an email channel, or have the bot chat/join groups via DeltaChat.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat channel for me
say_en.note: Runs the installation steps and configures email
Use it to add the bot in the DeltaChat app

say_en.text: Connect my DeltaChat group to the agent
say_en.note: Links the messaging group to an agent group
